conditionsList: A three-year university degree (Bachelor's level) in economics, management, law or a related field.
Five years of professional experience related to public finance (recognition of prior learning may be accepted).
A complete application file submitted before the intake closes.
home.modalitesPresentiel: On campus — Messa Campus, Yaoundé (25 places per specialisation).

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy and personal data protection for PSSFP applicants.
privacy.intro: The PSSFP attaches great importance to protecting applicants' personal data. This policy describes the data collected through the application portal, the purposes for which it is processed and the rights available to you.
privacy.contactLabel: Contact point for any question or request concerning your data:

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
body: The data controller is the Advanced Programme of Specialisation in Public Finance (PSSFP), Messa Campus, Yaoundé — Cameroon.
The designated contact point for data protection matters is the Head of the PSSFP information systems department, reachable at the address given at the end of this document.

sections.heading: 2. Applicable law and jurisdiction
body: The processing described in this policy is governed by Cameroonian law. The Cameroonian courts alone have jurisdiction over any related dispute.

Any complaint regarding the processing of your data may be addressed to the PSSFP at the contact address given at the end of this document and, failing a satisfactory reply, brought before the competent national authority for the protection of personal data.

sections.heading: 3. Data collected
list: Identity data: title, surname, first name, date and place of birth, gender, nationality, marital status.

Contact data: phone number(s) and email address — both are mandatory, the email address carrying all official communications up to the admission decision — together with postal address, city and country.
Academic and professional data: qualification, institution, year awarded, professional situation, employer.
Passport photograph uploaded by the applicant.
Minimal technical security data: IP address and timestamp on sign-in and submission.

sections.heading: 4. Purposes
list: Creating and managing the applicant account.
Assembling, processing and assessing the application file by the admissions committee.
Communicating with the applicant (submission confirmation, requests for further documents, decision).

sections.heading: 5. Legal basis
body: Processing is based on the applicant's consent, collected through a dedicated checkbox at registration, and on the PSSFP's legitimate interest in organising its recruitment procedures and keeping them secure.

sections.heading: 6. Recipients and processors
body: Your data is intended for authorised PSSFP departments and members of the admissions committee. It is neither sold nor transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.
The following technical processors handle data on our behalf, strictly within the scope of their assignment:
list: Cloudflare, Inc. (United States) — Turnstile anti-robot protection service. The IP address and technical browsing signals are transmitted; no application data is. This service is retained for portal security: without it, the public form would be exposed to automated submissions.
Short message (SMS) delivery provider — phone number and content of the authentication message.
Email delivery provider — email address and content of notifications.
Hosting of the platform and of supporting documents.

sections.heading: 7. Transfers outside Cameroon
body: Use of the anti-robot protection service mentioned above entails a transfer of technical data outside Cameroonian territory. That transfer is limited to the data strictly necessary to detect automated submissions and includes no part of the application file.

sections.heading: 8. Retention period
body: The data of unsuccessful applicants is retained for the duration of the intake and for up to twenty-four (24) months after the results are published, then archived or deleted.

The data of admitted applicants is retained for ten (10) years from publication of the results, the period required to manage studies, issue degrees and evidence the course of study. This period is distinct from that of the student record, which is governed by the institution's own archiving rules.

sections.heading: 9. Security
body: The PSSFP implements appropriate technical and organisational measures: encrypted communications (HTTPS), private storage of documents (photograph, acknowledgement of receipt) through time-limited signed links, access control and logging of sensitive actions.

sections.heading: 10. Data breach
body: In the event of a data breach likely to create a risk to your rights, the PSSFP informs the competent national authority without undue delay and, where the risk is high, notifies the individuals concerned directly by email at the address recorded in their file.

sections.heading: 11. Your rights
body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and port your data, as well as the right to withdraw your consent.
To exercise these rights, write to the contact address quoting your file number. You will receive a reply within a maximum of thirty (30) days of receipt of the request.
Withdrawing consent may prevent your application from being processed further.

sections.heading: 12. Cookies
body: The portal only uses cookies strictly necessary for it to work (maintaining a secure session, remembering your chosen language, anti-robot protection). No advertising tracking cookie is placed.

cgu.title: Terms of use
cgu.metaDescription: Terms of use of the PSSFP online application portal.
cgu.intro: These terms of use (the "Terms") govern access to and use of the online application portal of the Advanced Programme of Specialisation in Public Finance (the "PSSFP"), available at apply.pssfp.org. By creating an applicant account, you acknowledge that you have read and unreservedly accepted these Terms.
cgu.privacyRefBefore: The processing of personal data collected through the portal is described in our
cgu.privacyRefAfter: , which applicants are invited to read. Using the portal constitutes acceptance of that policy.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
body: The portal allows anyone meeting the admission requirements to assemble and submit an application online for a PSSFP intake. It constitutes neither a promise of admission nor an undertaking by the PSSFP to look favourably on any application.

sections.heading: 2. Account creation and security
list: The applicant's user ID is their phone number in international format; the password is a confidential 6-digit code (PIN) chosen by the applicant.
The applicant is solely responsible for keeping their PIN confidential and for all actions carried out from their account.
If the PIN is forgotten, a reset procedure by SMS code is available. Failing that, the applicant may contact the PSSFP.

sections.heading: 3. Accuracy of information
body: The applicant undertakes to provide accurate, complete and up-to-date information. Any inaccurate declaration, falsified document or identity fraud results in immediate rejection of the application, without prejudice to possible legal proceedings.

sections.heading: 4. Application fee
body: Completing an application requires payment of the XAF 50,000 application fee at a CREMINCAM branch (Crédit Mutuel d'Investissement du Cameroun), quoting the file number issued on submission. This fee covers the administrative processing of the file and is non-refundable, whatever the admissions committee decides.

sections.heading: 5. Handing in the paper file
body: Submitting online is not enough to make an application admissible. The complete paper file must be handed in at the PSSFP Registrar's Office (Yaoundé-Messa, room 231) by the announced closing date and time at the latest. This requirement applies to all applicants, including those enrolled in distance learning.

sections.heading: 6. Processing of the application
body: Applications are examined by the PSSFP admissions committee according to its own criteria. The applicant is informed by email and/or telephone of progress and of the final decision on their file.

sections.heading: 7. Availability and liability
body: The PSSFP endeavours to keep the portal available but cannot be held liable for interruptions due to maintenance, force majeure or factors beyond its control (network, hosting, the applicant's device). Applicants are advised not to wait until the deadline to submit their file.

sections.heading: 8. Intellectual property
body: All elements of the portal (trade marks, logos, texts, layout) are the property of the PSSFP. Any unauthorised reproduction is prohibited.

sections.heading: 9. Amendment of the Terms
body: The PSSFP reserves the right to amend these Terms at any time. The applicable version is the one in force at the time the portal is used.

sections.heading: 10. Governing law
body: These Terms are governed by Cameroonian law. Any dispute falls within the jurisdiction of the courts of Yaoundé, failing an amicable settlement.
